_comment: Each entry in 'vulnerabilities' accepts a known finding that cannot be
reads this file and fails the CI job if any CRITICAL or HIGH finding is
id          - CVE or GHSA identifier, e.g. 'CVE-2024-12345'
packageName - Affected package name as reported by Trivy
reason      - Why this cannot be patched now (required, non-empty)
expiresAt   - ISO 8601 date after which the entry is no longer valid.
The script treats expired entries as unapproved findings.
Maximum 90 days from the date of addition.
addedBy     - GitHub username or team that approved this entry
addedAt     - ISO 8601 date this entry was added
To add an entry: open a PR with the new entry and a link to the upstream
issue or patch release timeline. A second reviewer must approve the PR.
See SECURITY.md § Container scanning for the full process.
